incident-bot: ALERT: p95 latency spike detected for /v1/generate after rollout (release/2026-03-17). p95 > 2.6s, error rate up 1.8%. Auto-page to #incidents. link: https://pager.redwood/INC-2026-03-17-01

alice_oncall: I’m on it. Picking up pager, starting triage. Any customer reports yet? :eyes:

dylan_prod: Seeing 3 customer tickets mentioning timeouts for chat flows, one enterprise with SLA concern. Notified AE.

ben_runtime: Quick snapshot from canary: kernel selector flip to new-optimizer landed in rollout. I’m seeing frequent kernel-fallbacks on slice workers -> CPU path, plus batch-size oscillation. Logs: `kernel_select: failing to compile optimized kernel -> fallback=legacy` and `batch_window_ms fluctuating 20-300ms`

carla_sre: Metrics: KV cache hit dropped 45% on affected clusters, eviction spike around the same time as rollout. Could be aggressive prefetch + new kernel interacting.

alice_oncall: Can we confirm scope? only eu-west-2?

ben_runtime: Mostly eu-west-2 and us-central fallback traces. Host-level oom not observed. Kernel thrash appears to increase latencies as requests fall back to slower exec path. Repro on staging with same config.

evan_support: Customer impact: 2 enterprise customers on Dedicated saw 5-10% request failures, others degraded latency. Risk of escalations.

alice_oncall: Propose immediate mitigation: flip feature flag that enables new kernel selector (ff:enable_new_kernel=false) and pause rollout. Who can flip?

ben_runtime: I can push the kill-switch. Command: `./ops/featureflip set enable_new_kernel false --env=prod --scope=global`

carla_sre: Also recommend temporarily increasing prefetch backoff to reduce KV pressure: `prefetch.window_ms=150 -> 50` on affected slices. That will reduce cache churn.

alice_oncall: Ben, go ahead with kill-switch. Carla, coordinate the prefetch change. I’ll update stakeholders and trigger rollback plan if it doesn’t stabilize in 5m. :arrow_forward:

ben_runtime: kill-switch applied at 1779991510. Patch rolled to control plane, new requests observe legacy kernel selection. Monitoring now.

carla_sre: Prefetch backoff decreased on eu-west-2 at 1779991545. KV hit rate climbing back slowly.

alice_oncall: Observability: p95 dropped from 2.6s -> 1.1s in 90s after changes. Error rate trending down.

dylan_prod: Notified account owners and posted interim status in customer channel. No immediate escalations so far.

evan_support: Tickets updated. Flagging for follow-up RCA with affected customers.

ben_runtime: Root cause hypothesis: new kernel selector interacts poorly with aggressive prefetch logic under certain sequence length distributions, causing compile thrash and fallback to legacy codepath; fallback plus prefetch eviction amplifies tail latency.

carla_sre: Agreed on hypothesis. Next steps: 1) roll back kernel selector feature entirely from release branch; 2) run targeted perf/stress with prefetch settings; 3) add guardrail to disable new selector automatically if fallback rate > X% in a minute.

alice_oncall: Will schedule rollback if any regression returns. For now we stabilized. Handoff to night oncall: @frank_night_oncall — please keep monitoring eu-west-2 and us-central for next 3 hours, watch kernel_fallback_rate and kv_hit_rate.

frank_night_oncall: Ack. I’ll join post-handoff in 15m and keep hourly updates. If fallback_rate > 5% or p95 > 1.5s for 5m, I will escalate back to eng-runtime.

alice_oncall: Great. Documenting incident and creating INC ticket for RCA. Thanks everyone. :heart:

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-03-17-01 created. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-03-17-01
